items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: But Pete Brown, I did so many dates with Pete.

ctx.x: records with Pete Brown. Pete Brown did a lot of records with Teddy Wilson, then he did a lot with I think it was, oh Frank Newton and of course Procope's an old hand at the game. But Pete Brown, I did so many dates with Pete.
Pete was a very jovial person, wasn't he?

Yes, he was, and he was five times bigger than that little alto saxophone he played. But he could swing, he could really play. He was a good riff man. He always used to--well in the record dates I was on, whoever was leading would tell Pete to set a riff for the rest of the band and he was a good riff man just to set a riff and everybody start riffing behind him.
